scope: Local HTTPS/TLS verification: twelve direct Rust crates, Rust/Go/Ruby toolchains, pinned Go/Ruby SDK graphs and Bundler, container inputs, BuildKit/SBOM generator and release Actions. Added tokio-rustls 0.26.6 with ring/tls12 and Ruby 4.0.9, Bundler 4.0.23, Storage gem 1.62.1; all 35 checked inputs are CURRENT.

freshness_check.follow_up: All 35 inputs report CURRENT with no freshness exceptions. The detector checks the real direct Cargo resolution edges, including duplicate-named transitive package versions, and the Go/Ruby SDK manifests. The existing daily 03:17 UTC workflow fetches locked packages and runs the detector without an ecosystem runtime requirement. Scheduled remote execution and release-platform verification remain unobserved; runtime/container/SDK behavior is recorded separately by the TLS slice.

direct_dependencies.name: serde_json
direct_dependencies.purpose: Read ledger, bounded runtime configuration and official dependency metadata without a general schema engine.
direct_dependencies.maintenance: Official publisher release v1.0.154 published 2026-10-11; actively maintained.
direct_dependencies.resolution_constraints: Cargo.lock records the full graph; newest stable direct release verified independently of the manifest range.

direct_dependencies.name: tokio
direct_dependencies.purpose: Bounded async runtime, sockets, signals, synchronization and deadlines.
direct_dependencies.maintenance: Official publisher patch release 2026-10-21; non-yanked stable status verified from the crates.io index on 2026-10-22. Reverts the timer runtime-handle removal.
direct_dependencies.resolution_constraints: Newest stable checked independently of manifest ranges; Cargo.lock updates only Tokio from 1.54.0 to 1.54.1 with unchanged features and minimum Rust version.

direct_dependencies.name: tokio-rustls
direct_dependencies.purpose: TLS 1.2/1.3 transport for the existing bounded Tokio/Hyper listener and verified HTTPS healthchecks.
direct_dependencies.maintenance: Rustls/Tokio integration publisher; release 0.26.6 published 2026-09-28. Latest non-yanked stable release verified from the official crates.io index on 2026-10-23.
direct_dependencies.resolution_constraints: Default features disabled; only ring and tls12 enabled. Cargo.lock pins rustls 0.23.46, rustls-pki-types 1.15.1 and ring 0.17.14. Reuse rustls-pki-types PEM parsing through re-exports; no additional direct parser, HTTP framework, certificate generator or platform trust-store dependency. The existing HTTP/1 limit is preserved.

direct_dependencies.name: hyper

direct_dependencies.resolution_constraints: No HTTP/2, TLS or client features; latest stable direct release independently verified.

direct_dependencies.name: hyper-util

direct_dependencies.resolution_constraints: Only Tokio adapters enabled; no extra server framework.

direct_dependencies.name: http-body-util

direct_dependencies.name: rusqlite

direct_dependencies.maintenance: Official rusqlite publisher; latest non-yanked stable verified from the crates.io index on 2026-10-21.
direct_dependencies.resolution_constraints: Default features disabled; bundled SQLite only. Cargo.lock pins libsqlite3-sys 0.38.2 and the full graph; no cache, pooling or extension features. No rust-version is declared by the crate.

direct_dependencies.name: bytes
direct_dependencies.purpose: Shared bounded byte chunks across HTTP, upload channels and disk readers.

direct_dependencies.resolution_constraints: Already used transitively by Hyper/Tokio; direct use shares their Bytes type without a second buffering layer.

direct_dependencies.name: md-5

direct_dependencies.maintenance: RustCrypto publisher; latest non-yanked stable and active upstream development verified on 2026-10-21.

direct_dependencies.name: crc32c

direct_dependencies.maintenance: Official publisher; latest non-yanked stable and active upstream development verified on 2026-10-21.

direct_dependencies.name: getrandom

direct_dependencies.maintenance: Microsoft-maintained windows-rs bindings; official registry's newest stable non-yanked release verified 2026-10-22.

sdk_ecosystems.resolution_constraints: go.mod and go.sum record the graph. Storage v1.70.0 requires the stable auth v0.24.1, replacing the earlier auth pseudo-version; transitive versions follow upstream requirements. OAuth2 v0.37.0 was already present in the committed direct SDK requirements; this snapshot now records it explicitly. Freshness checks cover every direct require, excluding prereleases and retractions from the highest release's go.mod.

sdk_ecosystems.resolution_constraints: Gemfile uses exact direct pins and the official RubyGems registry; Gemfile.lock commits the complete graph, checksums, Ruby version and BUNDLED WITH version. The daily detector reads the real manifest, resolved direct lockfile pins, Bundler pin and .ruby-version, then compares official stable releases including new majors without requiring Ruby or Bundler on the checker host. RubyGems versions metadata excludes prereleases and yanked versions. Rails Active Storage remains a separate acceptance scope.
